name: Lob Play
idea: When a defender guards the wing too close, a back screen sends the wing to the rim, and a high pass goes over everyone.
why: A defender who stands in the passing lane is facing the ball, not the basket. A back screen behind them blocks the way to the hoop, and a high lob pass floats over every defender to the cutter right by the rim.
tryit: Passer: throw it high and soft, toward the front of the rim, so the cutter runs under it. Cutter: wait for the screen, then sprint to the hoop and look up for the ball.

frames.say: After a timeout, the coach draws up a lob. {X3} is guarding {3} so close that {3} can't catch a pass on the wing.
{5} steps out and sets a screen right behind {X3}.
{3} cuts behind the screen, straight to the rim. {X3} runs into {5}!
*Lob:* {1} throws a high, soft pass over everyone to {3}.
Catch and lay it in! When a defender guards you too close, a lob goes right over them.
